answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the jade funding graph is rebuilt from the whisper history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 98 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator forfeits 98 bonds yet holds one position, and the zenith report publishes the merged exposure. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
